name: @philippfromme/bpmn-cli
description: Fluent, type-safe BPMN model construction and safe publication for TypeScript.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check:types && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-declarations.mjs
scripts.build:test: npm run clean && npm run check:types && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node --test "dist/*.test.js" && npm run package:check
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:test && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=70 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=75 "dist/*.test.js" && npm run package:check
